findings.quoted_text: If Stryker Finally Rejects any Deliverable for Milestone #1 or #2 in accordance with Article III, Stryker may terminate   this Agreement, which termination shall be effective immediately upon delivery of a Termination Notice to Conformis.

If Stryker Finally Rejects any Deliverable for Milestone #1 or #2 in accordance with Article III, Stryker may terminate this Agreement, which termination shall be effective immediately upon delivery of a Termination Notice to [PARTY_C].
findings.explanation: Only Stryker is granted the explicit right to terminate the agreement based on rejections, leaving [PARTY_C] vulnerable without reciprocal termination rights for client breaches under this mechanism.
findings.suggested_change: Provide mutual termination rights and ensure [PARTY_C] is fairly compensated for all work performed up to the date of termination if terminated by Stryker.

findings.quoted_text: All right, title and interest in and to the Improved Stryker Background IP will vest solely in Stryker. [PARTY_C] agrees to assign and hereby assigns to Stryker all right, title and interest in and to all Improved Stryker Background IP...
findings.explanation: The contract uses 'hereby assigns' language, which legally transfers intellectual property rights immediately upon creation/vesting, potentially before milestone payments are fully received.
findings.suggested_change: Explicitly condition the assignment and transfer of all intellectual property rights upon receipt of full payment for the corresponding milestones and deliverables.

findings.quoted_text: Stryker shall pay to [PARTY_C] the following milestone payments for the development work to be conducted hereunder if and when the following milestones are met, as follows: (a) Milestone #1 - Within thirty (30) days following the date on which Stryker receives the first prototype... $2,000,000; and (b) Milestone #2 - Within thirty (30) days following the date on which there is a design freeze... $3,000,000;
findings.explanation: Payments are strictly tied to specific milestones, and while Section 8.1 mentions a 'Milestone #3', no payment amount or schedule is provided in Section 3.5 for Milestone #3, risking uncompensated work.
findings.suggested_change: Explicitly define the payment amount, deliverables, and timeline for Milestone #3 in Section 3.5 and shorten payment terms.

findings.quoted_text: [PARTY_C] shall indemnify and hold harmless Stryker, its directors, officers, employees, Agents and Affiliates... against any and all claims... to the extent arising from or related to (i) any breach of [PARTY_C]' representations, warranties or obligations... (iv) any portion of a Claim alleging personal injury on account of product liability...
findings.explanation: [PARTY_C] is subjected to extensive and broad indemnification obligations covering breaches, laws, negligence, and product liability, exposing [PARTY_C] to potentially uncapped financial exposure.
findings.suggested_change: Introduce a mutual, overall cap on liability and indemnification obligations and exclude indirect or consequential damages for both parties.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sending over the agreement. I have reviewed it and would like to request a small adjustment before signing: - Regarding the relevant clause, only one party is granted the explicit right to terminate the agreement based on rejections, leaving [PARTY_C] vulnerable. We propose to provide mutual termination rights and ensure [PARTY_C] is fairly compensated for all work performed up to the date of termination. Thank you for your understanding, and I look forward to working together.
